snippet.title: Elysium | Official Gameplay Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Explore a fallen utopia, tame ancient tech, and build with friends in Elysium—a co-op sci-fi survival crafting game. Gather, craft, and battle rogue machines across island ruins as you restore power and shape your base.

💚 Wishlist on Steam for updates & launch news
